topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and outlines the lecture's focus on the molecular and cellular mechanisms governing the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen and Damage Recognition by Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system identifies infections and tissue injury through molecular patterns and diverse families of pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Cellular Dynamics and Systemic Impacts of the Inflammatory Response
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the cellular processes that execute and propagate acute inflammation, from leukocyte recruitment and lymphatic trafficking to severe systemic consequences.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Pathology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the mechanisms responsible for shutting down inflammation and repairing damaged tissues, alongside the chronic pathologies that develop when resolution fails.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Next Topic Preview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer wraps up the presentation and announces the topic of the next lecture.
